parts.cap: Short knurled aluminum screw-cap at top and a connected short neck. No detached floating cap or glass bottle lip.

ownership: Full source silhouette and cloth/aluminum parts retained. Body covers lower neck; no cap stroke crosses the cloth. Native g primary and w cap roles independent.

states.static_tiles: Inspected complete ancestry declares one fixed Canteen tile. Empty Canteen changes StartVolume only; no alternate static exterior is declared.
states.mapping: Reuse the same closed exterior for declared fill range, without painting exposed water, inventing an open lid/fill-level window or liquid animation. Actual current fill/seal and dynamic liquid painting are not exported; unsupported native state must retain native fallback at final integration.

camera: One fixed cardinal map-icon view, front of circular canteen; mild controlled cap top shading only. No object turnaround required for this fixed container entry.
geometry_policy: Manual geometry controls silhouette, connectivity, seams and palette ownership. Actual ImageGen may supply restrained local material/outline refinement; any proposed contour is reviewed before selection. No second isolation generation.
